title: [broadcom] saibcm-modules-legacy-th build fails: stale symlinks from prior kernel module builds
author: rustiqly
body:
## Description

Building `sonic-aboot-broadcom.swi` from a clean clone of current master (`32875b5f8`) fails when building `opennsl-modules-legacy-th`:

```
ln: failed to create symbolic link '.../arch/x86/module.lds': File exists
make[1]: *** [Makefile:15: /sonic/target/debs/bookworm/frr_10.5.1-sonic-0_amd64.deb] Error 128
```

Actually the error is:
```
ln: failed to create symbolic link '/usr/src/linux-headers-6.12.41+deb13-common-sonic/arch/x86/module.lds': File exists
```

## Root Cause

Three Broadcom kernel module packages build sequentially via `_AFTER` ordering:

1. **saibcm-modules** (first) — creates symlinks in `/usr/src/linux-headers-*-common-sonic/` with bare `ln -s`
2. **saibcm-modules-dnx** (second) — has `if [ ! -e ... ]` guards, so it skips existing symlinks ✅
3. **saibcm-modules-legacy-th** (third) — uses bare `ln -s` without guards, **fails** because symlinks already exist from step 1 ❌

The `saibcm-modules-legacy-th` directory was introduced in PR #25192 (as `saibcm-modules-legacy`) by copying from `saibcm-modules` without adding the existence guards that `saibcm-modules-dnx` has. PR #25871 renamed it to `legacy-th` but did not fix the bug.

## Affected Files

- `platform/broadcom/saibcm-modules/debian/rules` (lines 96-99) — no guards, but builds first so it works
- `platform/broadcom/saibcm-modules-dnx/debian/rules` (lines 96-107) — has `if [ ! -e ]` guards ✅
- `platform/broadcom/saibcm-modules-legacy-th/debian/rules` (lines 96-99) — no guards ❌

## Proposed Fix

Use `ln -sf` (force) instead of `ln -s` in all three `debian/rules` files. This is:
- Simpler than `if [ ! -e ]` guards
- Idempotent and defensive
- Standard practice in kernel module Makefiles (Linux's own `scripts/Makefile.build` uses `ln -sf`)

## Steps to Reproduce

```bash
git clone --recurse-submodules https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage.git
cd sonic-buildimage
make init
make configure PLATFORM=broadcom
make target/sonic-aboot-broadcom.swi
```

Build fails at `opennsl-modules-legacy-th` every time.

## Impact

**All broadcom aboot/onie image builds are broken on current master** — this is a guaranteed failure since the `_AFTER` ordering ensures `saibcm-modules` always creates the symlinks before `saibcm-modules-legacy-th` tries to.

/cc @lipxu

linkedPullRequests.title: [broadcom] Fix saibcm-modules symlink creation to be idempotent
linkedPullRequests.author: rustiqly
linkedPullRequests.body:
#### What I did

Fixed `saibcm-modules` and `saibcm-modules-legacy-th` kernel module packages to use idempotent symlink creation (`ln -sf`/`ln -sfn`) instead of bare `ln -s`.

#### Why I did it

**All broadcom image builds (aboot + onie) are broken on current master.** The three Broadcom kernel module packages build sequentially:

1. `saibcm-modules` → creates symlinks in shared `linux-headers-*-common-sonic/`
2. `saibcm-modules-dnx` → has `if [ ! -e ]` guards, skips existing symlinks ✅
3. `saibcm-modules-legacy-th` → uses bare `ln -s`, **fails** because symlinks already exist ❌

Error:
```
ln: failed to create symbolic link '/usr/src/linux-headers-6.12.41+deb13-common-sonic/arch/x86/module.lds': File exists
```

This was introduced in PR #25192 (which copied `debian/rules` from `saibcm-modules` without the guards that `saibcm-modules-dnx` has) and persisted through PR #25871 (rename to `legacy-th`).

#### How I did it

- Replace `ln -s` with `ln -sfn` for directory symlinks (`-n` prevents creating a symlink *inside* an existing target directory)
- Replace `ln -s` with `ln -sf` for the `module.lds` file symlink
- Remove redundant `rm` before symlink creation (`ln -sf` handles this)
- Applied to both `saibcm-modules` and `saibcm-modules-legacy-th`

**Note:** `saibcm-modules-dnx` lives in a separate submodule (`sonic-net/saibcm-modules`) and already has `if [ ! -e ]` guards. A separate PR to that repo will normalize it to use `ln -sf` for consistency.

#### How to verify it

```bash
git clone --recurse-submodules https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage.git
cd sonic-buildimage
make init
make configure PLATFORM=broadcom
make target/sonic-aboot-broadcom.swi
```

Without this fix: build fails at `opennsl-modules-legacy-th` with symlink error.
With this fix: all three kernel module packages build successfully.

Fixes #26449

/cc @lipxu
